Ensure proper planning, monitoring and evaluation of the programs, including the use of lessons learned to improve programming in close coordination with the Regional Officer for Program Support, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【岗位职责】 1. 参与光通信产品研发设计评审，从产品开发初期开展DFM（可制造性设计）及DFA（可装配性设计）分析，针对高精度Ferrule对准、插损控制及全检测试等关键工艺提出优化建议，提前消除量产风险。 2. 作为研发设计团队与生产制造团队之间的主要接口人，确保产品设计规范、装配公差要求及测试标准准确传递至生产现场；同时收集试产问题及量产瓶颈，推动研发团队快速完成设计优化。 3. 主导新产品试产阶段异常问题分析与改善，组织跨部门开展根因分析，制定并推动改善方案落地，完成验证闭环，确保产品良率及量产目标达成。 4. 持续推进已量产产品的工艺优化与效率提升，支持自动化组装及自动化测试方案的需求定义、验证与导入，提升生产效率和产品一致性。 5. 在新产品导入项目较少期间，为研发团队提供产品开发及样品验证支持，保障产品开发流程稳定运行。 【任职要求】 1. 本科及以上学历，光学工程、材料科学、机械工程、电子封装等相关专业。 2. 两年以上光连接、光器件、光模块或高精度光电子产品制造行业NPI相关工作经验； 3. 具备新产品导入、试产推动及量产爬坡经验。 4. 熟悉光通信产品开发流程及NPI管理流程； 5. 具备从产品设计冻结（Design Freeze）到量产导入全过程的DFM优化及良率提升经验； 6.熟悉光通信产品测试流程，包括插入损耗（IL）、回波损耗（RL）等常规光学性能测试； 7. 熟悉Ferrule组装工艺、连接器装配工艺及相关制程控制要求； 8. 掌握8D、Fishbone、5 Why等常见问题分析及根因改善工具； 9. 具备较强的跨部门沟通协调能力，能够高效推动研发、制造、质量等团队协同解决问题。 【英语要求】（必须） 具备优秀的英语听说读写能力； 能够使用英语与海外研发团队、制造团队及客户进行日常技术沟通； 英语六级（CET-6）或更高水平优先。 【加分项】 具有光纤连接器、MPO/MTP、MT Ferrule、光模块等产品NPI经验； 具有自动化装配或自动化测试项目导入经验； 具有国际化企业或跨国项目协作经验； 熟悉数据中心、高速光互连、AI算力相关光连接产品者优先。

review_candidates.title: Motorway Resident Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview We are seeking an experienced Resident Engineer to join our established motorway asset renewal team, overseeing the delivery of maintenance and capital renewal projects across the Greater Dublin motorway network. The successful candidate will be responsible for supervising construction activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, to specification, on programme, and in compliance with contract requirements. The role primarily involves the supervision of pavement renewal works, with additional involvement in drainage, ducting, structures, and associated motorway infrastructure projects. Due to operational requirements and traffic management constraints, the position involves predominantly night-time working. Your role Act as Resident Engineer on motorway renewal and maintenance projects. Supervise contractors undertaking pavement rehabilitation and resurfacing works. Oversee drainage, ducting, structures, and associated civil engineering works as required. Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with contract specifications, quality standards, and health and safety requirements. Undertake inspections, audits, and quality assurance checks. Review and maintain site records, including daily diaries, progress reports, and inspection documentation. Monitor programme delivery and identify potential risks or delays. Liaise with contractors, client representatives, local authorities, emergency services, and other stakeholders. Attend site meetings and contribute to project reporting. Ensure traffic management measures are implemented and maintained in accordance with approved plans. Assist with the administration of construction contracts and the assessment of contractor performance. Support the wider project team in the successful delivery of motorway asset renewal programmes. About You Essential Requirements Level 8 degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Relevant years of post-graduate experience in civil engineering construction supervision or project delivery. Demonstrable experience in pavement renewal, road maintenance, or highway infrastructure projects. Strong knowledge of construction quality assurance and site supervision practices. Experience working with contractors and multidisciplinary project teams. Ability to work within a team and also work independently and under own initiative to achieve project goals. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities. Full clean driving licence. Willingness and ability to work predominantly night shifts. PSDP/PSCS awareness and a strong understanding of health and safety legislation. Computer literate and with experience of relevant software (AutoCAD or similar) and Microsoft Office programmes. Experience in administering contracts using the Public Works form of contracts; including processing of Valuations, and assessment of Claims. Desirable Requirements Chartered Engineer (CEng) status with Engineers Ireland or equivalent professional institution. Experience on motorway, national road, or major transport infrastructure projects. Familiarity with forms of contract used on public infrastructure projects. Knowledge of pavement engineering, drainage systems, roadside technology ducting, and structures maintenance. Personal Attributes Professional and collaborative approach. Strong relationship-building skills with clients, contractors and stakeholders. Proactive and self-motivated. Ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Commitment to safety, quality and continuous improvement. Flexible and adaptable to changing project requirements and working hours. And combine our hybrid working culture, international remote working opportunities, and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life. Be rewarded. Find out more. review_candidates.title: Manager Capital Delivery, Melton City Council
review_candidates.description: Lead one of Victoria's largest local government capital programs, for one of Australia's fastest-growing municipalities. Lead a $200m+ capital delivery program, with an established PMF and EPMO Advise the CEO and Executive on investment, risk and delivery performance Oversee a high-performing team with high levels of engagement The City of Melton is growing faster than almost anywhere in the country, with new suburbs, roads, sports precincts, community centres and open spaces being planned and built each year. Behind that growth sits an annual capital delivery program of more than $200m a year, requiring an experienced leader to manage the Capital Delivery Team and work closely across the organisation to ensure continuous improvement in delivery performance. Council has an established Project Management Framework and EPMO to embed project governance, reporting, and delivery standards across the Capital Delivery portfolio, supporting consistent and effective project execution. The role Reporting to the Director City Delivery, you will lead Council's Capital Delivery team in planning and delivering a program of 200+ projects annually. These cover transport, recreation, open space, and community infrastructure. You will: Oversee the full project delivery lifecycle, from pre-planning, design, procurement, construction and handover. Work in partnership with the EPMO to implement and embed project governance, reporting, and delivery standards across the Capital Delivery portfolio, supporting consistent and effective project execution. Strengthen project governance, forecasting and executive reporting under Council's Project Management Framework. Lead, coach and grow a capable team, maintaining and nurturing a high level of performance and a positive culture. Advise the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on investment, risk and delivery performance. Prepare and manage the department budget and drive a strong safety culture across staff and contractors. About you You are an experienced capital works leader, with a proven track record in delivery of large capital works programs and who combines delivery discipline with sound political judgement, exceptional people leadership and stakeholder engagement. You will bring: A tertiary qualification in engineering, project management, urban design, town planning, recreational planning or a related field. Substantial experience delivering capital works across feasibility, pre-planning, design and construction, ideally in or for the public sector. Proven senior leadership of project management across a medium or large organisation. A track record of building high-performing teams and influencing key decisions. Strong financial, operational and project planning capability. The ability to work confidently with elected officials in a complex, political environment. How to apply To obtain a copy of the candidate pack, copy and paste https://tinyurl.com/Melton-Capital-Delivery into your browser or contact Charlie Cole on charlie@camdensearch.com.au with any specific questions. Applications close on Thursday 26th November and should include your CV and a cover letter that broadly addresses your suitability for the role. All applications and enquiries will be treated with strict confidence. Third party or direct applications will be forwarded to Camden Search. Melton City Council is a child safe organisation. The successful candidate will need to complete a National Police Check and a Working with Children Check. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, and people from all cultural backgrounds.
